title: Vertical rectangular prism
spec: Create a new coordinate system by setting the Euler angles to negative ninety degrees, zero degrees, and negative ninety degrees, and set the translation vector to zero, zero, and zero. In the first face, draw the first loop by creating four lines. Start with the first line from the origin (zero, zero) to (zero point one one three nine, zero), then draw the second line from (zero point one one three nine, zero) to (zero point one one three nine, zero point seven five). Continue with the third line from (zero point one one three nine, zero point seven five) to (zero, zero point seven five), and finish with the fourth line from (zero, zero point seven five) back to the origin. Scale the two-dimensional sketch by applying a scale factor of zero point seven five. Rotate the scaled two-dimensional sketch using the Euler angles: negative ninety degrees, zero degrees, and negative ninety degrees. Translate the rotated two-dimensional sketch using the translation vector: zero, zero, and zero. Extrude the transformed two-dimensional sketch along the normal direction by zero point zero zero seven three units, ensuring that no extrusion occurs in the opposite direction and that a new solid body is created. The final dimensions of the vertical rectangular prism with slightly rounded edges are: length zero point one one three eight nine three three seven six four one three five seven zero two eight units, width zero point seven five units, and height zero point zero zero seven two six nine seven eight nine nine eight three eight four four nine one one units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.box(0.1139, 0.75, 0.0073, centered=(False, False, False))

# The box function does not create rounded edges, so we need to create the sketch manually
r = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.1139, 0).lineTo(0.1139, 0.75).lineTo(0, 0.75).close()

# Extrude the sketch to create the 3D object
r = r.extrude(0.0073)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation
# The Euler angles (-90, 0, -90) correspond to a rotation of 90 degrees around the X-axis and then 90 degrees around the Z-axis
r = r.rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), 90).rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), 90)

# The translation vector is [0, 0, 0], so no translation is needed

# Final model
r  # This will represent the final model

import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.1139, 0).lineTo(0.1139, 0.75).lineTo(0, 0.75).close()

# Extrude the sketch
extrusion = sketch.extrude(0.0073)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation
# The Euler angles are (-90, 0, -90) and the translation vector is (0, 0, 0)
# This transformation is equivalent to rotating the object 90 degrees around the X-axis and then 90 degrees around the Z-axis
transformed = extrusion.rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), 90).rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), 90)

# The final model
r = transformed

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.1139, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.1139, 0.75) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.75) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.0073)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation
# The Euler angles are (-90.0, 0.0, -90.0) and the translation vector is (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
# This transformation is equivalent to rotating the object 90 degrees around the X-axis and then 90 degrees around the Z-axis
r = r.rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), 90) \
     .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), 90)

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane on the XZ plane
r = cq.Workplane("XZ")

# Define the rectangle dimensions
thickness = 0.0073  # X dimension
width = 0.1139      # Y dimension
height = 0.75       # Z dimension

# Draw the rectangle and extrude
r = r.rect(width, height).extrude(thickness)

# Translate to align with bounding box
r = r.translate((0, 0, 0))

import cadquery as cq

r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Rectangle
r = r.moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.00365, 0).lineTo(0.00365, 0.1139).lineTo(0, 0.1139).close().extrude(0.75)

# Cylinder Cutout 1
cutout1 = cq.Workplane("YZ").center(0.1, 0.375).circle(0.0015).extrude(0.0073)
r = r.cut(cutout1)

# Cylinder Cutout 2

r = r.cut(cutout2)
